zh: 做企业AI落地这么久
en: I have been implementing AI in businesses for a while.

zh: 我发现一个特别有意思的职场默契
en: I have noticed an interesting workplace understanding.

zh: 一家公司里真正会用AI的人
en: In a company, those who really know how to use AI

zh: 全在集体装不会
en: all pretend that they do not.

zh: 表面上大家得过且过
en: On the surface, everyone just gets by.

zh: 敲代码改方案全靠手动
en: They write code and revise proposals by hand.

zh: 老板开AI研讨会所有人齐刷刷摇头
en: When the boss holds an AI seminar, everyone shakes their head.

zh: 这个东西不靠谱误差大没法落地
en: “It is unreliable, inaccurate, and impractical.”

zh: 可背地里下班回家练Z6
en: But privately, they go home and practice Z6,

zh: Cursor和Codex
en: Cursor, and Codex.

zh: 上班老板一转身工具一开
en: At work, they open the tools as soon as the boss turns away.

zh: 10分钟干完一天的活
en: They finish a day’s work in ten minutes,

zh: 然后继续潜水深藏功与名
en: then stay quiet and keep their achievements hidden.

zh: 全公司心照不宣嘴上都说AI不行
en: Everyone understands: publicly, they say AI is no good.

zh: 私下个个都在偷偷提速
en: Privately, they are all quietly speeding up.

zh: 很多老板觉得这是员工懒不配合
en: Many bosses see this as laziness and a lack of cooperation.

zh: 我实话告诉你
en: Let me tell you honestly:

zh: 这根本不是人的问题这是机制的问题
en: this is not a people problem; it is a problem with the system.

zh: 你换个角度想
en: Think about it from another angle.

zh: 员工会用AI
en: An employee uses AI

zh: 效率翻三倍结果是什么
en: and becomes three times as efficient. What happens?

zh: 是加薪吗是减负吗都不是
en: A raise? Less work? Neither.

zh: 那么大概率是老板一句效率这么高
en: Most likely, the boss says, “You are so efficient,

zh: 那再多加两个项目
en: take on two more projects.”

zh: 最后呢活越干越多工资一分没涨
en: The workload grows, but the pay does not rise by a cent.

zh: 换你你也藏着用
en: You would keep it to yourself too.

zh: 所以我们做企业AI落地
en: So when we implement AI in a business,

zh: 从来不是把工具买回来发个通知就完事了
en: buying tools and issuing a notice is not enough.

zh: 你真正要解决的核心问题只有一个
en: There is one central question to resolve.

zh: 效率提升之后
en: Once efficiency improves,

zh: 省出来的时间和产能到底怎么分配
en: how will the time and capacity saved be shared?

zh: 是全部摊成新的工作量
en: Will it all become more work,

zh: 还是让员工分享增效的红利
en: or will employees share in the gains?

zh: 是把AI变成压榨员工的新工具
en: Will AI become another way to squeeze employees,

zh: 还是变成整个组织降本增收的武器
en: or help the whole organization cut costs and grow revenue?

zh: 给所有想做AI的老板三个建议
en: Three suggestions for bosses who want to implement AI.

zh: 第一呢就是别搞
en: First, avoid this equation:

zh: AI提效等于加量不加价
en: AI efficiency means more work for the same pay.

zh: 省下的工时要给员工冗余
en: The hours saved should give employees some slack,

zh: 而不是无限堆活
en: rather than endless extra work.

zh: 第二呢就是建立增效分成机制
en: Second, create a system for sharing productivity gains.

zh: 用AI省下的成本拿出一部分来反哺团队
en: Return some of the costs saved through AI to the team.

zh: 大家才有动力公开用全力推
en: That gives people a reason to use it openly and support it.

zh: 第三呢就是把个人偷偷用的AI能力
en: Third, turn the AI skills people use privately

zh: 变成标准化的组织工作流
en: into standardized workflows for the organization:

zh: 统一培训统一工具统一交付
en: shared training, shared tools, and shared delivery standards,

zh: 而不是靠员工私下内卷
en: instead of leaving employees to compete privately.

zh: AI落地拼的从来不是谁的工具更先进
en: AI implementation is not about having the most advanced tools.

zh: 拼的是你能不能把员工偷偷摸鱼的工具
en: Can you turn a tool employees quietly use to slack off

zh: 变成企业和员工共赢的生产力
en: into productivity that benefits both the company and its people?

zh: 那么机制顺了不用你催
en: When the system works, you do not need to push people.

zh: 所有人都会主动把AI用起来
en: They will take the initiative to use AI.

zh: 关注超哥只讲AI落地的底层逻辑
en: Follow Chao Ge for the underlying logic of AI implementation.
